description: This file is a shell script used for testing the diff-highlight tool in a Git environment. It defines test functions for verifying diff-highlight's behavior with various types of diffs, including line modifications, UTF-8 characters, graphical representations, and merge conflicts.

methods.name: dh_test
methods.description: A helper function that performs a diff test by creating patches, commits, and applying diff-highlight to verify output against expected results.

methods.name: test_strip_patch_header
methods.description: Removes patch headers from diff output, starting from the first line that begins with '@@'.

methods.name: dh_test_setup_history
methods.description: Sets up a git commit graph with specific branches and commits to test diff-graph highlighting.

methods.name: left_trim
methods.description: Removes leading whitespace from input lines, used for formatting diff output.

methods.name: trim_graph
methods.description: Removes graph-specific characters from diff output to normalize it for comparison.
